question_text: Mkpụrụedemede Igbo nwere mkpụrụ okwu ole?
explanation: Mkpụrụedemede Igbo nwere mkpụrụ okwu iri atọ na isii (36) gụnyere ụdaume asatọ na mgbochiume iri abụọ na asatọ.

question_text: Ụdaume ole ka e nwere n'asụsụ Igbo?
explanation: Asụsụ Igbo nwere ụdaume asatọ (8): a, e, i, o, u, ị, ọ, ụ.

question_text: Mgbochiume ole ka e nwere n'asụsụ Igbo?
explanation: Asụsụ Igbo nwere mgbochiume iri abụọ na asatọ (28).

question_text: N'asụsụ Igbo, 'Ụlọ' pụtara n'asụsụ Bekee:
explanation: 'Ụlọ' pụtara 'house' n'asụsụ Bekee. Ụlọ akwụkwọ=school, Ụka=church, Ahịa=market.

question_text: Mkpụrụ okwu Igbo 'Nwoke' pụtara n'asụsụ Bekee:
explanation: 'Nwoke' pụtara 'man' n'asụsụ Bekee. Nwanyị=woman, Nwa=child, Nna=father.

question_text: Mkpụrụ okwu Igbo 'Nwanyị' pụtara n'asụsụ Bekee:
explanation: 'Nwanyị' pụtara 'woman' n'asụsụ Bekee. Nwoke=man, Nwa agbọghọ=girl, Nne=mother.

question_text: Okwu Igbo 'Nna' pụtara n'asụsụ Bekee:
explanation: 'Nna' pụtara 'father' n'asụsụ Bekee. Nne=mother, Nwanne=brother/sister.

question_text: Okwu Igbo 'Nne' pụtara n'asụsụ Bekee:
explanation: 'Nne' pụtara 'mother' n'asụsụ Bekee. Nna=father, Nwa=child, Di=husband.

question_text: Mkpụrụ okwu Igbo 'Nwa' pụtara n'asụsụ Bekee:
explanation: 'Nwa' pụtara 'child' n'asụsụ Bekee. Okenye=adult, Nne=mother, Nna=father.

question_text: Okwu Igbo 'Ụgbọ ala' pụtara n'asụsụ Bekee:
explanation: 'Ụgbọ ala' pụtara 'car' n'asụsụ Bekee. Ụgbọ igwe=bicycle, Ụgbọ njem=bus, Ụgbọ okporo ígwè=train.

question_text: N'asụsụ Igbo, 'Ọ na-eri nri' pụtara:
explanation: 'Ọ na-eri nri' pụtara 'he is eating' n'asụsụ Bekee. Ọ na-aṅụ mmiri=he is drinking, Ọ na-esi nri=he is cooking, Ọ na-ehi ụra=he is sleeping.

question_text: N'asụsụ Igbo, 'Ọ ga-abịa echi' pụtara:
explanation: 'Ọ ga-abịa echi' pụtara 'he will come tomorrow' n'asụsụ Bekee. Ọ bịara ụnyaahụ=he came yesterday, Ọ na-abịa ugbu a=he is coming now, Ọ bịara taa=he came today.

question_text: N'asụsụ Igbo, 'Ha na-egwu egwu' pụtara:
explanation: 'Ha na-egwu egwu' pụtara 'they are playing' n'asụsụ Bekee. Ha na-abụ abụ=they are singing, Ha na-agba egwu=they are dancing, Ha na-arụ ọrụ=they are working.

question_text: N'ọdịnala Igbo, emume 'Iri ji' bụ emume nke:
explanation: Emume 'Iri ji' bụ emume nke iri ji ọhụrụ n'afọ, nke a na-eme n'ọnwa Ọgọọst.

question_text: N'ọdinala Igbo, a na-akpọ eze Igbo:
explanation: N'ọdịnala Igbo, a na-akpọ eze Igbo 'Igwe'. Obi bụ eze ndị Igbo nke Anambra, Eze bụ eze ndị Igbo nke Enugwu.

question_text: Ilu Igbo 'Onye kwe, Chi ya ekwe' pụtara:
option_a: If you work hard, you will succeed
option_b: If you agree, your Chi will agree
option_c: If you pray, God will answer
option_d: If you run, you will catch
explanation: Ilu 'Onye kwe, Chi ya ekwe' pụtara na ihe ọ bụla mmadụ kwenyere ime, Chi ya ga-enyere ya aka ime ya.

question_text: N'akụkọ ihe mere eme Igbo, a na-akpọ eze Nri:
explanation: N'akụkọ ihe mere eme Igbo, a na-akpọ eze Nri 'Eze Nri', onye bụ onye ndú ime mmụọ nke ndị Igbo.

question_text: Mkpụrụ okwu Igbo 'Ọkụkọ' pụtara n'asụsụ Bekee:
explanation: 'Ọkụkọ' pụtara 'chicken' n'asụsụ Bekee. Ewu=goat, Ehi=cow, Atụrụ=sheep.

question_text: Okwu Igbo 'Ehi' pụtara n'asụsụ Bekee:
explanation: 'Ehi' pụtara 'cow' n'asụsụ Bekee. Ewu=goat, Atụrụ=sheep, Ezi=pig.

question_text: Mkpụrụ okwu Igbo 'Ewu' pụtara n'asụsụ Bekee:
explanation: 'Ewu' pụtara 'goat' n'asụsụ Bekee. Ehi=cow, Atụrụ=sheep, Nkịta=dog.

question_text: Okwu Igbo 'Atụrụ' pụtara n'asụsụ Bekee:
explanation: 'Atụrụ' pụtara 'sheep' n'asụsụ Bekee. Ewu=goat, Ehi=cow, Ịnyịnya=horse.

question_text: N'ọdịnala Igbo, emume 'Ọnwa Asatọ' bụ emume nke:
explanation: Emume 'Ọnwa Asatọ' bụ emume iri ji ọhụrụ n'afọ nke ndị Igbo na-eme.

question_text: N'akụkọ ihe mere eme Igbo, aha eze Nri mbụ bụ:
explanation: Aha eze Nri mbụ n'akụkọ ihe mere eme Igbo bụ Eze Nri Ìfikuọjim.

question_text: Ilu Igbo 'Aka nri ata aka ekpe' pụtara:
option_b: The right hand washes the left
explanation: Ilu 'Aka nri ata aka ekpe' pụtara na anyị kwesịrị inyere ibe anyị aka n'ihi na aka nri na-asacha aka ekpe.

question_text: Mkpụrụ okwu Igbo 'Akụkọ' pụtara n'asụsụ Bekee:
explanation: 'Akụkọ' pụtara 'story' n'asụsụ Bekee. Abụ=song, Egwu=dance/game.

question_text: N'ọdịnala Igbo, emume 'Igba Mgbá' bụ emume nke:
explanation: Emume 'Igba Mgbá' bụ emume agbamakwụkwọ nke ndị Igbo na-eme mgbe ha na-alụ nwanyị.

question_text: N'akụkọ ihe mere eme Igbo, a na-akpọ ala Igbo:
explanation: N'akụkọ ihe mere eme Igbo, a na-akpọ ala ndị Igbo 'Ala Igbo', nke sitere na okwu 'Ibo' ma ọ bụ 'Igbo'.

question_text: Ilu Igbo 'Nwata kwọọ ụkwụ, o mee onye isi ụlọ' pụtara:
option_a: A child who washes his hands eats with elders
option_b: A child who is trained will lead
option_c: A child who works hard will succeed
option_d: A child who is stubborn will suffer
explanation: Ilu 'Nwata kwọọ ụkwụ, o mee onye isi ụlọ' pụtara na nwata nke a zụrụ azụ ga-enwe ezi ihe ga-eme na ndụ ya.

question_text: Mkpụrụ okwu Igbo 'Ụzọ' pụtara n'asụsụ Bekee:
explanation: 'Ụzọ' pụtara 'road' n'asụsụ Bekee. Ụlọ=house, Ụlọ akwụkwọ=school, Ahịa=market.

question_text: N'ọdịnala Igbo, emume 'Ọnwa Iri na Atọ' bụ emume nke:
explanation: Emume 'Ọnwa Iri na Atọ' bụ emume iri ji ọhụrụ n'afọ nke ndị Igbo na-eme.

question_text: N'akụkọ ihe mere eme Igbo, a na-akpọ eze Onitsha:
explanation: N'akụkọ ihe mere eme Igbo, a na-akpọ eze Onitsha 'Igwe Onitsha'.

question_text: Ilu Igbo 'Eze mụọ nwa, eze adaala' pụtara:
option_a: When a king gives birth, the kingdom suffers
option_b: A king's child is not a king
option_c: A king's child must be respected
option_d: A king's child will become king
explanation: Ilu 'Eze mụọ nwa, eze adaala' pụtara na mgbe eze mụrụ nwa, eze enweghị ike ịchị eze nke ọma.

question_text: Mkpụrụ okwu Igbo 'Ahịa' pụtara n'asụsụ Bekee:
explanation: 'Ahịa' pụtara 'market' n'asụsụ Bekee. Ụlọ=house, Ụlọ akwụkwọ=school, Ụka=church.

question_text: N'ọdịnala Igbo, emume 'Ịgba Ọgwụ' bụ emume nke:
explanation: Emume 'Ịgba Ọgwụ' bụ emume ọgwụgwọ ọrịa nke ndị Igbo na-eme.

question_text: N'akụkọ ihe mere eme Igbo, a na-akpọ eze Enugwu:
explanation: N'akụkọ ihe mere eme Igbo, a na-akpọ eze Enugwu 'Eze Enugwu'.

question_text: Ilu Igbo 'Onye ji ihe rie ihe' pụtara:
explanation: Ilu 'Onye ji ihe rie ihe' pụtara na onye nwere ihe ga-eri ihe, ọ bụghị onye na-enweghị ihe.

question_text: N'asụsụ Igbo, 'Anyị ga-aga ahịa' pụtara:
explanation: 'Anyị ga-aga ahịa' pụtara 'we will go to market' n'asụsụ Bekee. Anyị ga-aga ụka=we will go to church, Anyị ga-aga ụlọ akwụkwọ=we will go to school, Anyị ga-ala ụlọ=we will go home.

question_text: Mkpụrụ okwu Igbo 'Ụka' pụtara n'asụsụ Bekee:
explanation: 'Ụka' pụtara 'church' n'asụsụ Bekee. Ụlọ alakụba=mosque, Ụlọ arụsị=temple, Ụlọ mgbe ochie=shrine.

question_text: N'ọdịnala Igbo, emume 'Ịgba Egwu' bụ emume nke:
explanation: Emume 'Ịgba Egwu' bụ emume ịgba egwu nke ndị Igbo na-eme n'oge ememme dị iche iche.

question_text: N'akụkọ ihe mere eme Igbo, aha eze Nri nke abụọ bụ:
explanation: Aha eze Nri nke abụọ n'akụkọ ihe mere eme Igbo bụ Eze Nri Nàmó.

question_text: Ilu Igbo 'Ọnụ bụ ọnụ, anya bụ anya' pụtara:
option_a: The mouth is the mouth, the eye is the eye
explanation: Ilu 'Ọnụ bụ ọnụ, anya bụ anya' pụtara na ịnụ ihe abụghị ịhụ ya.

question_text: Mkpụrụ okwu Igbo 'Ụlọ akwụkwọ' pụtara n'asụsụ Bekee:
explanation: 'Ụlọ akwụkwọ' pụtara 'school' n'asụsụ Bekee. Ọbá akwụkwọ=library, Ụlọ ọgwụ=hospital, Ụka=church.

question_text: N'ọdịnala Igbo, 'Ọfọ' bụ ihe nnọchianya nke:
explanation: 'Ọfọ' n'ọdịnala Igbo bụ ihe nnọchianya nke eziokwu na ikpe ziri ezi, nke a na-eji ekpe ikpe.

question_text: N'akụkọ ihe mere eme Igbo, Omenala bụ:
explanation: N'akụkọ ihe mere eme Igbo, Omenala bụ ọdịnala nke ndị Igbo na-agbaso.
